company.name: EasyPost
company.shortDescription: EasyPost provides a simple postage API that allows developers to quickly and painlessly integrate shipping into any e-commerce application.
company.description: EasyPost is a technology leader that builds shipping solutions for ecommerce brands, fulfillment providers, online marketplaces and businesses of all sizes. The company provides a best-in-class multi-carrier shipping API that removes the technical complexities of logistics while making shipping more reliable, efficient, and affordable.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $25,000,000, or 28.18% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,292,060 to $391,335,425, a 73.95x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
